candidates.source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek (VVZ) – Czech Public Procurement Bulletin
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated publication venue under zák. 134/2016 Sb. for contract notices (oznámení o zahájení zadávacího řízení) and award notices (oznámení o výsledku zadávacího řízení) above/below EU thresholds. Any public-sector banking, acquiring, payment-terminal or payment-infrastructure contract must surface here first, with CPV codes, estimated value, awarded supplier and price.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled form-search scraping of /SearchForm/Search filtered by CPV (66110000 bankovnictví, 66172000 zpracování finančních transakcí, 30160000/30144200 payment/card devices, 72xxx IT services) plus keyword filters; prefer the NIPEZ open-data export where equivalent records exist.
queries_used: Věstník veřejných zakázek vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz oznámení o výsledku zadávacího řízení bankovní služby

candidates.source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek – NIPEZ instance (vvz.nipez.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: The VVZ operated by MMR under the NIPEZ umbrella; appears to be the current/parallel technical entry point for the uveřejňovací subsystém (publication subsystem) and eForms-era notice forms. Same legal notice corpus as vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz but a distinct host worth tracking so a platform migration does not silently break collection.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor as canonical-host candidate; crawl notice detail pages; check whether cdz.vvz.nipez.cz (certified electronic tools / central data repository) exposes structured feeds.
queries_used: otevřená data Věstník veřejných zakázek data.gov.cz dataset isvz.nipez.cz open data XML export

candidates.source_name: NEN – Národní elektronický nástroj (National Electronic Tool)
candidates.why_relevant: State-operated e-procurement platform where a large share of central-government and many municipal authorities run the whole procedure. Contract detail pages carry zadávací dokumentace (tender documents), technical specifications, Q&A, bid-opening records and award data — far richer than a VVZ notice. Confirmed to contain payment-acceptance tenders, e.g. card-acceptance and terminal-rental services and cashier/POS system deliveries.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginated crawl of /verejne-zakazky listing (cs and /en mirror), then per-contract detail + /zadavaci-dokumentace document harvest; key on the N006-YY-Vxxxxxxxx contract identifier for deduplication against VVZ.
queries_used: NEN nen.nipez.cz veřejná zakázka platební terminály
NEN Czech e-procurement tender payment terminals banking services

candidates.source_name: Věstník NEN
candidates.why_relevant: NEN's own bulletin view of notices published from the platform — a chronological, filterable stream that is the lowest-latency way to catch newly launched banking/payment procedures inside NEN before they propagate elsewhere.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily poll of the věstník listing with pagination parameters (p:vestnik:page=N pattern observed in URLs); keyword + CPV filter downstream.
queries_used: NEN nen.nipez.cz veřejná zakázka platební terminály

candidates.source_name: Registr DNS (NEN dynamic purchasing systems register)
candidates.why_relevant: Central register of dynamické nákupní systémy (DNS) run in NEN. DNS/framework agreements are how much Czech public ICT and payment-hardware buying actually happens: a vendor admitted to a DNS then wins repeated mini-tenders that may never appear as standalone headline notices. Tracking DNS scope + admitted suppliers reveals the medium-term competitive field for payment infrastructure.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate DNS entries; for ICT/payment-relevant DNS capture categories, admitted supplier list and each mini-tender (výzva k podání nabídky) issued under it.
queries_used: portal-vz.cz NIPEZ dynamický nákupní systém DNS otevřená data veřejné zakázky ISVZ

candidates.source_name: ISVZ – Informační systém o veřejných zakázkách (statistics + open data)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory information system (§224 zák. 134/2016 Sb.) offering market overviews, central registers, a contracting-authority-profile validator, and an OpenData section. This is the bulk/structured route into the same notice corpus — far better for systematic time-series collection than scraping notice HTML.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read the open-data help PDF, then pull the periodic bulk exports from /opendata into a local store keyed by contract ID; reconcile with NEN and VVZ IDs.
queries_used: otevřená data Věstník veřejných zakázek data.gov.cz dataset isvz.nipez.cz open data XML export

candidates.source_name: Portál o veřejných zakázkách (portal-vz.cz) – MMR methodology hub
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry for Regional Development's authoritative map of the NIPEZ ecosystem: which subsystem publishes what, the uveřejňovací subsystém, IS VZ, NIPEZ commodity catalogue, methodologies, decision databases and annual reports on the state of public procurement. Best single starting node for snowballing further CZ procurement sources and for understanding what is legally required to be published where.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl for methodology/regulatory changes and for annual Výroční zpráva o stavu veřejných zakázek; use as link-discovery seed rather than a content feed.
queries_used: portal-vz.cz NIPEZ dynamický nákupní systém DNS otevřená data veřejné zakázky ISVZ
local_language_terms_used: výroční zpráva o stavu veřejných zakázek

candidates.source_name: NIPEZ podpora – Registr veřejných zakázek (rules & data structures)
candidates.why_relevant: Documents the Registr veřejných zakázek: the central record that ingests contract data from all certified electronic tools (not just NEN) and redistributes it to consumers, per MMR-issued data-structure descriptions. Essential for designing collection: it defines the schema and the machine-readable path to the full national corpus including private e-tools.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to extract data-structure specs and any published endpoint list; re-check on schema version changes.
queries_used: otevřená data Věstník veřejných zakázek data.gov.cz dataset isvz.nipez.cz open data XML export

candidates.source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (NKOD) – data.gov.cz
candidates.why_relevant: National open-data catalogue that indexes procurement-adjacent datasets (confirmed to carry e.g. the ÚOHS decision collection dataset). Use it to discover which procurement/contract datasets are officially published, by whom, in what format, and with what licence — a licence-and-provenance layer over the raw portals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the catalogue API/search for 'veřejné zakázky', 'smlouvy', 'ÚOHS' publishers; register the distribution URLs found for periodic pull.
queries_used: ÚOHS sbírka rozhodnutí veřejné zakázky databáze uohs.cz sbirky.uohs.cz

candidates.source_name: Registr smluv (smlouvy.gov.cz) via portal.gov.cz service
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory contract register: public bodies must publish contracts above CZK 50,000 excl. VAT, and an unpublished contract is legally ineffective. This is where the actual signed acquiring/terminal/banking-service contract text, pricing schedules and annexes appear — often the only place the real commercial terms of an awarded tender become visible.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the register's bulk/open-data dumps (monthly XML) rather than UI scraping; filter by supplier ICO (acquirers, terminal vendors) and by keyword in subject line.
queries_used: hlidacstatu.cz veřejné zakázky API registr smluv smlouvy.gov.cz bankovní služby

candidates.source_name: Hlídač státu – Hlídač veřejných zakázek & Hlídač smluv (API)
candidates.why_relevant: NGO aggregator that normalises the contract register, the public-procurement register and ÚOHS decisions into one searchable corpus with a documented public API — dramatically cheaper to query than the official portals, and it links suppliers to contracts to political/ownership context. Best used as an accelerator and cross-check, with official registers as the source of truth.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Register for an API token and use /api/v1 endpoints for smlouvy and verejnezakazky with supplier ICO and keyword queries; verify any decision-critical fact against VVZ/NEN/registr smluv.
queries_used: hlidacstatu.cz veřejné zakázky API registr smluv smlouvy.gov.cz bankovní služby

candidates.source_name: ÚOHS – Sbírky rozhodnutí (public procurement review decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: The competition/procurement review authority's decision collection (since 1999). Challenged tenders produce decisions that expose evaluation criteria disputes, technical-specification bias claims and bid pricing — an unusually rich indirect window into how banking/payment tenders were actually structured and contested, and which suppliers fight.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the NKOD-published ÚOHS decisions dataset or the Hlídač mirror for bulk; keyword-filter for platební terminál, akceptace karet, bankovní služby, platební brána.
queries_used: ÚOHS sbírka rozhodnutí veřejné zakázky databáze uohs.cz sbirky.uohs.cz

candidates.source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (CZ notices, CPV-filtered)
candidates.why_relevant: Above-EU-threshold Czech notices are forwarded to TED, giving a machine-readable, multilingual, eForms-structured duplicate of the highest-value CZ banking/payment tenders — with a stable API and CPV taxonomy. Excellent cross-border comparability layer and a hedge against CZ-portal scraping fragility.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API with country=CZ and CPV 66110000/66172000/66000000/30144200/48xxx/72xxx; join to VVZ/NEN by notice reference. Note TED only covers above-threshold, so it must not replace VVZ/NEN.
queries_used: CPV kód 66110000 bankovní služby 66172000 zpracování platebních transakcí veřejná zakázka NIPEZ komoditní katalog

candidates.source_name: E-ZAK (QCM) certified electronic tool – multi-authority profiles
candidates.why_relevant: One of the dominant certified elektronické nástroje in CZ; hundreds of ministries, regions, hospitals and utilities run their profil zadavatele on an E-ZAK instance (each on its own subdomain). Many banking/payment tenders live only as a VVZ pointer plus the full documentation on an E-ZAK profile. Confirmed instances include the Czech National Bank (ezak.cnb.cz) and the Ministry of Agriculture (zakazky.eagri.cz).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Build a registry of E-ZAK instance subdomains for banking-relevant contracting authorities (from the VVZ profile-address field / ISVZ profile validator), then crawl each instance's contract list on a shared parser — E-ZAK page structure is uniform across instances.

candidates.source_name: TENDER ARENA (Tender systems s.r.o.)
candidates.why_relevant: Second major commercial certified e-tool / profil zadavatele host. Directly relevant to this cell: Národní rozvojová banka (the state development bank) publishes its procurement profile here, making it a must-track host for state-financial-institution buying.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl per-authority profile pages (/profil/{CODE}); anonymous read of published contracts, no bidder account needed for the public profile view.
queries_used: Česká národní banka profil zadavatele veřejné zakázky Národní rozvojová banka Česká pošta zadavatel

candidates.source_name: Vhodné uveřejnění (vhodne-uverejneni.cz) – profil zadavatele host
candidates.why_relevant: Another widely used profil zadavatele host; carries a profile page for Česká národní banka (ICO 48136450). Profiles here are indexed by ICO, which makes it a convenient ICO-keyed entry point for tracking a named financial-sector contracting authority across time.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /profil/{ICO} for the shortlist of banking-relevant authorities; parse contract lists and attached documents.

candidates.source_name: Gemin.cz – profil zadavatele / e-procurement tool
candidates.why_relevant: Certified e-tool used notably for small-scale contracts (veřejné zakázky malého rozsahu) — the tier where individual terminal purchases, payment-gateway subscriptions and small integration jobs sit, below VVZ publication duty. Reported as the profile address for the Czech National Bank. Small-scale contracts are precisely the layer that never reaches VVZ or TED.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Confirm the exact live profile path for each target authority (search results indicate a /profil/{slug} pattern) then crawl; treat as the small-scale-contract complement to VVZ.

candidates.source_name: E-ZAKAZKY.CZ
candidates.why_relevant: A further certified profil zadavatele provider in the fragmented CZ e-tool market. Included for completeness of the host inventory: because Czech authorities freely choose their e-tool, no single platform gives full coverage and the host list itself must be maintained as a source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Include in the host registry; crawl only those authority profiles that appear on the banking-relevant shortlist.

candidates.source_name: Česká národní banka – Veřejné zakázky / úřední deska
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank as a contracting authority under zák. 134/2016 Sb. Its tenders cover payment-system, cash-handling and financial IT infrastructure — the highest-signal single buyer in this cell. The page is the authoritative pointer to whichever e-tool profile currently hosts its contracts (E-ZAK instance ezak.cnb.cz observed).

candidates.why_relevant: State development bank (ICO 44848943) procuring banking IT, payment and back-office services as a public contracting authority; publishes via TENDER ARENA. A second high-signal financial-sector buyer distinct from commercial banks (which are not covered by procurement law).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the page for profile-host changes; crawl tenderarena.cz/profil/NRB for the contract stream.

candidates.why_relevant: The Finance Ministry both procures state banking/treasury services and runs centralised/joint purchasing (společný nákup) for its resort — a structural driver of large aggregated payment and financial-service contracts. Central-purchasing pages reveal aggregation intent before individual notices appear.

candidates.why_relevant: Czech-language browser of the CPV taxonomy including the financial-and-insurance-services division. Practical utility: it gives the exact Czech labels for the CPV codes to filter on (bankovnictví 66110000, zpracování finančních transakcí a služby zúčtovacího střediska 66172000), which is what makes precise CZ-language querying of VVZ/NEN possible.

candidates.why_relevant: The official citizen-portal service card for VVZ. Useful as a stable, government-maintained pointer that names the current canonical VVZ endpoint and operator — a cheap way to detect when the bulletin migrates hosts (a real risk given the vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz / vvz.nipez.cz duality).

negative_findings.description: No documented public REST API for Věstník veřejných zakázek or NEN was found. The only structured route surfaced is the ISVZ OpenData section (isvz.nipez.cz/opendata) plus a methodological help PDF, and the NIPEZ 'Registr veřejných zakázek' documentation describing data structures for inter-tool exchange rather than an open developer endpoint.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in cs and en returned portal and documentation pages, no API reference. Bulk open data appears to be the intended machine route; endpoint shapes and update cadence remain unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for this cell will likely rest on bulk open-data pulls plus HTML crawling, not on a clean API — this materially changes effort estimates and freshness expectations.

negative_findings.description: Commercial banks operating in CZ (ČSOB, KB, Česká spořitelna, etc.) are not contracting authorities under zák. 134/2016 Sb. for their ordinary commercial buying, so their vendor selections for payment infrastructure do not appear in VVZ/NEN. Searches for bank-side tender publication in this cell surfaced only the public-sector institutions (ČNB, NRB) and state bodies.
negative_findings.result_summary: No legally mandated CZ notice channel found for private-bank procurement of payment terminals or acquiring technology.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The A2 procurement workstream can only cover the public/state-financial slice of the CZ banking-and-payments demand side; private-bank vendor selection must be covered by other workstreams (vendor announcements, press, references).

negative_findings.description: Veřejné zakázky malého rozsahu (small-scale contracts, below the statutory thresholds) carry no VVZ publication duty and may appear only on an individual authority's profil zadavatele — or nowhere at all beyond the later contract entry in Registr smluv.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed structurally from the publication-duty framing on portal-vz.cz and from Gemin being described as used for small-scale contracts; no central register of small-scale banking/payment purchases was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Individual terminal purchases, payment-gateway subscriptions and small integrations — the high-frequency, low-value layer most indicative of day-to-day vendor share — are systematically invisible in the headline register.

negative_findings.description: No consolidated public list of certified electronic tools (certifikované elektronické nástroje per vyhláška 260/2016 Sb.) and their operators was located during this pass; the e-tool landscape had to be assembled by snowballing individual vendors (E-ZAK, Tender Arena, Gemin, vhodne-uverejneni, e-zakazky).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned vendor sites and individual authority profiles, not an authoritative registry page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without the authoritative certified-tool list, host coverage is assembled ad hoc and may miss whole platforms, silently under-covering some contracting authorities.

negative_findings.description: Two parallel VVZ hostnames were observed in results — vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz and vvz.nipez.cz (plus cdz.vvz.nipez.cz). Which is currently canonical, and whether one merely redirects, was not established; no fetch was performed to adjudicate.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both appear in current search results with live-looking content; relationship unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pointing a collector at the non-canonical host risks silent staleness or duplication; this must be resolved by the deterministic verification pass before collection is configured.

coverage_gaps.description: Mini-tenders awarded inside dynamic purchasing systems and framework agreements (DNS / rámcové dohody) generally do not generate individual high-visibility notices, yet they are how much CZ public ICT and payment-hardware volume is actually placed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate ICT- and payment-relevant DNS entries in the NEN Registr DNS, capture admitted-supplier lists, and monitor each DNS for výzvy k podání nabídky rather than relying on top-level notice streams.

coverage_gaps.description: Because each contracting authority chooses its own certified e-tool, full documentation coverage requires a maintained registry mapping banking-relevant authorities (ICO) to their current profil zadavatele host. No such mapping exists yet for this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an ICO→profile-URL table from the VVZ/ISVZ profile-address fields and the ISVZ profile validator; re-verify quarterly since authorities migrate hosts.

coverage_gaps.description: This pass established the platform layer but not the empirical query vocabulary: no systematic enumeration was done of the Czech phrasings actually used in banking/payment tender titles (e.g. akceptace platebních karet, pronájem platebních terminálů, platební brána, zúčtování, bankovní služby vedení účtů, pokladní systém, provozování platebního styku).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a title-corpus pass over NEN and VVZ search results for each candidate phrase, measure hit counts and noise, and freeze a scored keyword list alongside the CPV filters.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal and regional buyers are a major demand pool for card acceptance and terminals (the confirmed Přerov card-acceptance tender is an example), but sub-national authorities are spread across many e-tools and were only sampled here, not mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the authority registry to the 13 kraje, statutory cities and large hospital/utility buyers, and prioritise those with recent payment-acceptance activity.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage of this cell is thin by nature: NEN offers an /en mirror and TED carries English translations of above-threshold notices, but below-threshold CZ notices and all tender documentation are Czech-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Czech as the primary collection language and use the NEN /en mirror and TED English only for cross-checking and for analyst-facing summaries; budget for machine translation of zadávací dokumentace.

coverage_gaps.description: Rate limits, robots policies and terms of use for NEN, VVZ and the commercial e-tool hosts were not examined in this pass, and the Hlídač státu API's key/quota terms are unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before building collectors, review robots.txt and terms for each host and obtain a Hlídač API token; prefer official bulk open data wherever it substitutes for crawling.

brief: The Czech public-procurement notice layer for banking and payments is unusually well-structured and legally anchored: zák. 134/2016 Sb. forces contract and award notices into the Věstník veřejných zakázek, while NEN (nen.nipez.cz) carries the full procedure — tender documentation, Q&A, awards — for state and many municipal buyers, and confirmed cases such as card-acceptance-and-terminal-rental tenders show the cell produces real signal. Around that core sit a machine-readable layer (ISVZ OpenData, the NIPEZ Registr veřejných zakázek, TED for above-threshold notices, Registr smluv for the signed contract text) and an aggregator layer (Hlídač státu's API, ÚOHS review decisions) that together make systematic tracking feasible without an official API. The two structural weaknesses are fragmentation and invisibility: each authority picks its own certified e-tool (E-ZAK, Tender Arena, Gemin, vhodne-uverejneni, e-zakazky), so full documentation coverage needs a maintained ICO→profile-host registry, and both small-scale contracts and DNS mini-tenders bypass the headline notice streams entirely. Note also a hard scope boundary: private commercial banks are not contracting authorities, so this cell covers only public and state-financial demand (ČNB, NRB, MF, municipalities) — private-bank vendor selection must be sourced elsewhere.
